PART III – LANDSPART III – LANDS
Land Redemption Notices
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Order under Section 39(a)(1)

The allotments specified in the Order No.299 of 2013 made under the Proviso (a) to Section 38 of the Land Acquisition Act (Chapter 460) and published in the Gazette Extra ordinary No. 1830/51 dated 4th October 2013 are vested absolutely in the State and the possession of which has been taken for or on behalf of the State under Paragraph (a) of Section 40 of the aforesaid Act. But by the virtue of powers vested in me by Sub section (1) of Section 39 (a) (inserted by Act No.8 of 1979) of the Land Acquisition Act, I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation, do hereby divest only the allotments specified in the Schedule below.
K. D. Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Lands and Irrigation.

My No.: 4-3/10/2012/LRB/115. Land Acquiring Officer’s No.: WGSWD&EIP/ACQ/MH/05.Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation,“Mihikatha Medura”, Land Secretariat,1200/6, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla,24th July, 2025.SCHEDULE

THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Revocation Order under Section 39(1)

The allotment of land specified morefully in the Order No.299 of 2013 dated 30.09.2013 made under the Proviso (a) to Section 38 of the Land Acquisition Act, and published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 1830/51 dated 04.10.2013 was vested in the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka. The possession of the land depicted below has not yet been taken for and on behalf of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka. Therefore, I, Kuragamage Don Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation, by virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 39(1) of the Land Acquisition Act, do hereby revoke the Order in respect of the land specified in the Schedule of
the Order No. 299 of 2013 dated 30.09.2013 published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 1830/51 dated 04.10.2013.
K. D. Lal Kantha, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation.
